r.name: IT Consultants
r.tagline: Technology that works for your business.
r.description:
You Choose, We Deliver
We are an independent IT consulting and services company that helps customers transform digitally and realise the opportunities for better business outcomes. Headquartered in Johannesburg, South Africa our customers are based throughout South Africa, Africa and the world at large. Our services include Digital Consulting, DevOps, Mobile and Web App Development, Cloud Migration, Change and Transformation, Technical and Agile Development Managed Service solutions and Emerging Technology services.

Our IT Consultancy Expertise
Our people, combined with our industry insights, methods and technology acumen ensures we have the ability to design, develop and implement the optimal technology solutions for our clients. Our specific expertise is in financial services, government, public sector, policing, health and energy and utilities

r.name: Property Management
r.tagline: Letting, sales and management you can trust.
r.description:
Boom and Wow Property Management is the leading property rental agency across South Africa, letting and managing residential properties across all major metropolitan areas. Boom and Wow Property Management has a wide selection of homes to rent, to suit all budgets, tastes and areas.

If you’re looking for apartments, houses, freestanding homes or flats to rent, our professional team of rental agents will make the process of searching, viewing, renting and moving into a new home as time efficient, convenient and comfortable as possible.

For landlords and property investors, Boom and Wow Property Management’s multi-channel marketing, industry experience, brand visibility and pre-screened tenant waiting lists, ensures that your residential property investments are quickly and effectively leased to approved tenants at competitive rentals. Boom and Wow Property Management ensures that all the correct tenant application screening and legal processes are followed with signing a new lease, thereby safeguarding and maximising rental income on rental properties.

r.title: About Us
r.content:
Boom & Wow Holdings is a diversified group of businesses united by one standard: exceptional service.

From our salon and liquor store to IT consulting, property management and events, every business is run by people who care about the details.

One account gives you access to all of them.

Experienced Management

The management team is made up of experienced and successful business man. The company also intends initiating partnerships with other big companies in order to form synergies that will engender productivity and long term partnerships.

Our target market
We will aim to attract and retain customers by ensuring an excellent customer service and mutual respect. The basis of our relationship will be our aim to provide an efficient and reliable service that our clients can always depend on.
